cards.quote: Complexity is O(n^2) for arbitrary data, but approaches Θ(n) if the list is nearly in order at the beginning.
cards.stem: What complexity is stated for arbitrary data?

cards.hint: Think about heavy objects settling down.
cards.quote: Also known as sinking sort, exchange sort.
cards.stem: Which alternative name is given for this sorting method?

cards.hint: Think about sorting inside the same list.
cards.quote: Generalization (I am a kind of ...) in-place sort, stable sort.
cards.stem: What kind of sort is this method said to be?

cards.hint: Think about skipping the settled tail.
options: decrement the last position checked on each pass
swap each nonadjacent pair in turn
repeat the pass even if no swaps are done
loop through all items blindly each time
cards.quote: Since at least one item is moved into its final place for each pass, an improvement is to decrement the last position checked on each pass.
cards.stem: What improvement is suggested for each pass?
